## Exact result and lifecycle

Proposed review lane: archive / validated research / shared tooling / canonical promotion.
For archive intake, name the isolated source inventory and scientific obligations
that remain partially reviewed. A lane declaration is not a verification exemption.

State the complete theorem/counterexample/computational proposition, all assumptions and quantifiers, and its classification. A merge does not promote the result.

## Public prerequisites and nearest work

Base SHA, theorem-state version, priority revision, task/method scope, predecessor comparison and live overlap. Link full public statements/proofs and distinguish audited-working premises.

## Evidence and falsification

Proof or exact code/inputs, arithmetic, parameter bounds, commands and actual output. Describe independent checking, known regressions and failure controls. State what is not proved and the exact remaining lemma.

## Verification handoff

List the focused tests/verifiers and integrity checks actually run, plus the
localized planner's classification and any errors or unresolved scope. Mark
required repository-wide certificate replay as **deferred to the merging
agent**; contributors need not run it to submit. If the change is workflow-only,
state that scope. Before merging, the merging agent records the tested final
integration commit/tree, PR head, base, environment, commands and results for
required full replay or the structural-check exemption. A deferred suite is not
a pass. See [verification ownership](https://github.com/1337isnot1337/erdos-99/blob/main/docs/ci/README.md#verification-ownership).

## Review and provenance

Link the continuing investigation/handoff thread and **Open next questions**:
exact remaining question, relevance, one feasible first action and blocker.
Optional workflow feedback belongs here or in that thread; no separate log is needed.

Exact proposed head; for canonical promotion, link the **single independent AI-agent mathematical audit** (full proof reconstruction and adversarial bridge/regression review), its agent/model when known, evidence, verdict and limitations. The project owner may operate the reviewer agent. No second agent or human mathematical review is required. Include contributor/source credit, AI role and rights/source notices. Intentional contributions are offered under Apache-2.0 as described in CONTRIBUTING.md.
